conviction_note: Q3/9M is new (not pre-released) and the stock has fallen 28% in 60 sessions with no company news, so a cut is being priced; the issuer pre-released both earlier guidance changes by MAR Art.17 ad-hoc (18 Oct 2024, 28 Jul 2026) yet has filed none 30 days after Q3 closed, and four board members bought up to 1 Oct, which leans toward a confirmed 17-23m EUR EBITA guide and relief. That is inference, not a sourced number, and the H2 ramp the guide needs (13.5m EUR+ against 12.6m underlying H2 2025, with flat YoY working days in Q3) is still a stretch, so p_up is 57 on an abs move of 6% = +0.84. The findings sum (+1.1) is a little larger because the decisive inference keeps its full size.

findings.finding: Amadeus Fire pre-released both of its recent guidance changes by MAR Art.17 ad-hoc on preliminary figures (18 Oct 2024 for 9M 2024, 28 Jul 2026 for H1 2026, 6 days before that report). As of 2026-10-30, 30 days after Q3 closed and one session before the 2 Nov release, its pressetext Pressefach shows no ad-hoc since 28 Jul. That points to the 17-23m EUR guide being confirmed rather than cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance cut by ad-hoc 28 Jul 2026: -7.16% that day (22.70 EUR). The release days after, with no guide change, ran -8.59% (30 Jul) and -5.67% (4 Aug, call day). The 18 Oct 2024 cut is outside the 6-month tape read here
findings.source_date: 2026-10-30 (Pressefach read; latest Amadeus Fire item 01.10.2026 19:05); precedent https://app.boersengefluester.de/en/newswire/DE0005093108/amadeus-fire-ag/adjusted-guidance-of-operating-ebita-for-full-year-2024-2011587 (2024-10-18)
findings.original_quote: Die Amadeus Fire Group erwartet nunmehr Umsatzerlöse in einer Bandbreite von 350 bis 365 Mio. € ... Das operative EBITA* wird für das Geschäftsjahr 2026 in einer Bandbreite von 17 bis 23 Mio. € prognostiziert (pta 28.07.2026: the guide that has not been touched since; no later Art.17 filing in the Pressefach)
findings.why_not_priced: The tape is pricing a cut: -28.5% over 60 sessions to 15.88 EUR (14.94 low on 22 Oct) with no company news since the July cut. If the market read the missing ad-hoc as a confirmation, the stock would have re-rated toward the post-cut ~21-22 EUR level rather than grinding lower. Three analysts, ~$0.3m a day of turnover, and nobody publishes ad-hoc absence as a signal
findings.independence: Board insider buying up to the MAR closed period (separate finding, https://www.pressetext.com/news/20261001020). The October ifo employment barometer firmed (https://www.cash-online.de/a/ifo-beschaeftigungsbarometer-steigt-firmen-bauen-weniger-stellen-ab-728907/)

findings.finding: Four board members bought shares on the open market between 4 Sep and 1 Oct 2026: SB Grimm 19.8k EUR at 19.79, CEO von Wuelfing 29.2k at 19.49, 26.8k at 17.89 and 24.7k at 16.48 (1 Oct), MB Wiederhold 22.1k at 17.68, MB Gerlitzki 34.2k at 17.10. The last buy came two days before the 30-day MAR closed period opened ahead of 2 Nov, when July-August figures were known internally.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Insiders also bought in March 2026 (von Wuelfing twice) and May 2026, before the July cut, so this group's buying has not reliably preceded good prints

findings.finding: The direct counterparties that reported Jul-Sep 2026 show German professional and permanent hiring still down YoY but stable sequentially: Hays Germany net fees -6% LFL, Perm -8% ('challenging but stable sequentially'), Finance -9%; Randstad Germany Professional -7%. Amadeus Fire's Personnel Services Q3 will therefore be down again YoY, as its guide assumed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 Personnel Services miss (placement -28% in H1) drove the July cut and a -7.16% day
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it lands inside a guide that explicitly assumed no improvement, so it is sized toward 0. The residual is the YoY decline in the most profitable PS line (placement)

findings.finding: Leverage is rising: net financial debt including leases was 140.7m EUR at 30 Jun 2026 against 137.4m at YE2025, and leverage was 3.5x rolling-12M EBITDA (40.2m) against 3.2x. The dividend was cancelled 'zugunsten der Kapitalstärkung'. With rolling EBITDA still falling, Q3 leverage is likely flat to higher, which makes the cash-flow line a downside risk.

findings.finding: From 1 Jul 2026 the reformed Grundsicherung (SGB II) restores a placement priority (Vermittlungsvorrang): job centres must first test immediate placement before approving training. That is a headwind to publicly funded training entries at Comcave and GFN in Q3, the segment that carried H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Comcave's 2025 publicly funded volume slump forced the 5.3m EUR restructuring in Q3 2025
findings.source_date: 2026 (article on the rule effective 2026-07-01; snippet-level, consumer advice site)
findings.original_quote: Seit dem 1. Juli 2026 gilt in der Grundsicherung für Arbeitsuchende wieder ein stärkerer Vermittlungsvorrang. Jobcenter sollen zunächst prüfen, ob Leistungsberechtigte unmittelbar in eine Ausbildung oder Beschäftigung vermittelt werden können.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a legal change no coverage of the name ties to Amadeus's training volumes, and the H1 report does not mention it. It is macro-to-company transmission, so it is sized small and its sign is uncertain: SGB III funding, the rule's exceptions and GFN's growth may offset it
findings.independence: none; the H1 report says June 2026 funded participants were 'deutlich mehr als im Vorjahresmonat', which cuts the other way
